data.title: bn-30u: refuted sealed candidates quarantine and converge to a re-seal
data.description:
Idempotent lifecycle for sealed-index candidates that open cannot admit.

WHAT CHANGED
- New crates/mess-store/src/sealed_candidate.rs: RefutationReason (unparsable / identity-mismatch / coverage-unproven / orphan), quarantine (rename the family out of the candidate namespace + directory fsync), SealedCandidateHealth (per-open observability).
- engine.rs load_sealed: now collects the sealed/ listing BEFORE classifying (renaming mid-readdir can skip entries), refutes+quarantines unparsable .seal/.pidx candidates, and records *.refuted markers left by earlier opens.
- engine.rs recover: refutes+quarantines identity-mismatch and coverage-unproven pending candidates instead of silently dropping them, sweeps unresolved pending candidates as orphans, and collects a SegmentSummary per scanned segment.
- engine.rs open_with: clones the committer's roll channel and re-queues owed segments onto the SAME background sealer a live roll uses. Trigger is the durable *.refuted marker (not the in-memory refutation), so a crash between the rename and the enqueue still converges. Live head is never enqueued.
- EngineMetrics gains 4 counters; LogEngine::sealed_candidate_health() carries the reason strings and pending-reseal ids.

REVIEW FOCUS
1. Quarantine-vs-delete: is one derived slot per (segment, kind) a real bound, or should there be a reaper?
2. The marker-driven enqueue: is 'durable marker + not footer-verified-admitted' the right fixed point? Does any crash sequence oscillate?
3. Rename order (siblings first, primary last) as the mid-quarantine crash contract.
4. The re-seal SegmentSummary is built from the recovery scan (epoch/base_pos from the header, end_pos=next_pos, content_len=safe_offset). Is content_len=safe_offset right for footer_finalize in every shape?
5. Live-head exclusion: keyed on active_seg_id from the resume plan, not on the highest file id. Correct under the headerless-newest-segment case?
6. Zero blast radius claim: a healthy store has no markers, so nothing is enqueued and open cost is unchanged.

EVIDENCE
- cargo nextest run -p mess-index -p mess-store: 405 passed, 10 skipped (22 new: 10 unit + 12 integration).
- cargo check --workspace --all-targets: clean. just fmt-check: clean. clippy -p mess-store --all-targets: no new warnings.
- cargo nextest run -p mess-cli: 40 passed (sidecar discovery is extension-keyed, so *.refuted is skipped like *.tmp).
- Mutation checks: disabling quarantine fails 5 integration tests; disabling the enqueue fails 8.
- NOT run (lead gates): full just test, mess-bench.

NOT TOUCHED (sibling workers bn-dbz / bn-dcr): zero changes under crates/mess-index.
